# Tech Stack: pai-orbit
Last updated: 2026-07-24

<!-- Generated by /setup from detected repo structure. Refine with /arch init. -->

## Services

| Service | Language | Framework | Key Dependencies |
|---------|----------|-----------|-----------------|
| core | Markdown (modes/skills/agents/templates) | Claude Code plugin conventions | none |
| hooks | bash | Claude Code hook event contract (PreToolUse/PostToolUse JSON over stdin/stdout) | `python3` (JSON parsing), `ruff` (Python lint hook), `eslint` (TS/JS lint hook) |
| adapters (claude-code, cursor-plugin, cursor, copilot, codex) | bash | none | `jq`/`python3` used ad hoc per adapter build script |

No application runtime, database, or frontend — this repo authors and distributes a
Claude Code plugin; there is nothing to run, only content to build and validate.

## Infrastructure

| Layer | Technology | Provider |
|-------|-----------|---------|
| Hosting | n/a — no hosted runtime | n/a |
| Database | n/a | n/a |
| Cache | n/a | n/a |
| Queue | n/a | n/a |
| Storage | git-committed `dist/` bundles | GitHub (`the-psi/pai-orbit`) |

## CI/CD

- **CI:** none detected (no `.github/workflows/`) — builds are run manually via `bash plugins/pai-orbit/build.sh`.
- **Artifact store:** `plugins/pai-orbit/dist/` (committed to git, not a separate artifact registry).
- **Deploy:** none — see `## Deploy` in `.claude/pai-orbit-config.md` for the release process (version bump, rebuild, tag, optional GitHub release).
